checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.text: We wrote to {email}. Open the link, then come back here and sign in.
checkEmail.hint: Not there? Check your spam folder, or sign in: we'll send you a new one.

captcha.unavailable: The anti-bot check couldn't load. Check your connection and try again.

soon.text: This section is coming in a future update of the app.

authErrors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with this email already exists.
authErrors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: An account with this email already exists: use another one.
authErrors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: To sign in you need to confirm your email address. We've sent you a new confirmation link.
authErrors.BANNED_USER: This account is suspended. If you think it's a mistake, write to us: the address is in the terms of use.
authErrors.MISSING_RESPONSE: Complete the bot check before continuing.
authErrors.VERIFICATION_FAILED: The bot check didn't pass. Please try again.
authErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a few seconds and try again.
